events.title: Late Fee Fog
events.prompt: A bill is due tomorrow. Paying early costs a little now. Waiting risks a late fee that feeds the Debt Cloud.

choices.label: Pay on time (−8 coins, protect score)
Wait and hope (−0 now, risk late fee)

events.explanation: On-time history is the strongest credit signal. Haste to spend later often costs more than patience now.

events.title: APR Whisper
events.prompt: A glowing tablet offers a quick loan. Low monthly number… high APR. Borrow for a want, or wait and earn?

choices.label: Take the high-APR loan for a want

events.explanation: APR is the true price of borrowed money. Low monthly payments can still mean a costly Kingdom trap.

events.title: Utilization Spikes
events.prompt: Your credit tablet shows you used almost all available limit. Paying it down now calms the Score Vault.
events.explanation: Credit utilization — how much of your limit you use — is a big score factor. Lower balances rebuild trust.

events.title: Two Doors
events.prompt: One door asks for collateral (secured). The other is unsecured but pricier. Which rebuilds trust safer?

choices.label: Choose the secured path with a clear plan
Take unsecured because it feels faster

events.explanation: Secured loans use collateral and often cost less. Unsecured loans are easier to open — and easier to regret.

events.title: Emergency Ledger
events.prompt: The Collector approaches. An emergency pouch lets you pay without new debt. Empty pouch means borrowing under pressure.

choices.label: Use emergency savings (−10 coins, no new debt)

events.explanation: An emergency fund is credit recovery armor — it keeps interest storms from feeding on haste.
